source: Live 12.4 bundled Max 9.1.5 m4l-ref docs + design/casestudy/inventory.py

elements.name: Dial
elements.avoid: The value is set once (number box) or shapes the picture (display value).

elements.name: Notched dial

settings.placement: 4 px higher than a plain dial

elements.use: A ± value whose centre means "unchanged": gains, EQ bands, pan, width.
elements.avoid: Centre is not a resting point (LFO amount, bias): use needlemode 2 without the triangle.

elements.name: Large dial

settings.appearance: 3 Large (50 × 63 box, bigger than Live's 37 px ring) or a larger appearance-0 box

elements.use: The control the device exists for; at most one per section, leading it.
elements.avoid: Two in one section, or a device with one band and ≤ 5 controls.

elements.name: Stepped dial

settings.labels: live.comment per step around the ring

elements.use: A few fixed steps that read like hardware (Glue attack/ratio, Limiter lookahead).
elements.avoid: More than about 7 steps (menu) or no hardware precedent.

elements.name: Number box
elements.use: A continuous value you set, or one that refines a dial (Fine, Trim, Window); columns that would overflow with dials.

elements.name: Bipolar number box
elements.use: A ± value you set (offsets, modulation depth, shift).
elements.avoid: A ± value you play: notched dial.

elements.name: Choice in a number box
elements.use: An ordered choice that reads like an amount (Hybrid Reverb Vintage: Off → Oldest).

elements.name: Display value
elements.use: A value that shapes the picture, placed inside the display next to it.

elements.name: Graph handle
elements.use: A point on the picture that edits two parameters (frequency and gain/width).
elements.avoid: A single value: display value or dial.

elements.name: Text toggle
elements.use: On/off on the body, named by what it switches on (Auto, Ping Pong, Mono).
elements.avoid: View or audition switches (icon toggle); enabling a section (checkbox).

elements.name: Icon toggle
elements.use: Audition, spectrum, sidechain, link and freeze switches; Ø next to a dial.
elements.avoid: When a word is clearer than an icon.

elements.name: Checkbox

settings.appearance: 0 Default on the body, 1 LCD in a display

elements.use: Enabling a section or feature; its values dim when off. Also legends in a display (Compressor GR / Output).
elements.avoid: Switching a mode (text toggle or segmented).

elements.name: Segmented pair
elements.use: Two (sometimes three) short options side by side: 12 | 24, Pre | Post, Hz | ♪.
elements.avoid: Options that change the whole picture: mode buttons in the display.

elements.name: Radio stack
elements.use: Three to four device modes in a column (Peak / RMS / Expand).

elements.name: Mode buttons
elements.use: Two or three modes that change the whole picture, at the top of the display.
elements.avoid: Settings that leave the picture alone.

elements.name: Menu
elements.use: Four or more choices on the body.
elements.avoid: A choice that belongs to the picture: chooser.

elements.name: Chooser
elements.use: A choice inside the display that the picture depends on (Scale, Algorithm, Routing, Lookahead).

elements.name: Trigger
elements.use: A one-shot action (Spectral Time Freeze, Drum Buss force-to-note).
elements.avoid: State you need to see afterwards: toggle.

other.name: Divider

settings.note: draws at the left edge of its rect

other.use: Between control groups; behind the mix column.

other.name: Label / section header
other.use: Section names (Input, Smoothing, Mode) and display labels.

settings.stereo: two meters, 4 px wide, 1 px apart (it is mono)

other.name: Display ground
other.use: Behind every display; the picture is a v8ui over the graph area only.

settings.bgfillcolor: body colour on the title-colour ground

settings.size: the design's size (Max rounds the box up)

other.name: Prev / next arrows
other.use: Browsing a list of files (Hybrid Reverb IR).

other.name: File drop
other.use: Over a picture that accepts a dropped file (Hybrid Reverb IR).

other.name: Fold-out arrow
other.use: Past about six controls; Live's title-bar arrow is not available to Max devices.

no_audio_effect_precedent.note: Fader. No Live 12 audio effect uses one; gains are dials (Utility, Limiter).
Fader with a built-in meter. No audio-effect precedent: use a dial plus live.meter~ in a display.
Waveform display. Allowed as a picture inside a display when a v8ui is not needed.
Envelope editor. Instruments only; an audio effect with an envelope uses dials (Auto Filter Envelope).
Bare flash dot. Live uses text buttons for triggers.

not_available_to_max.live: Page tabs in the title bar (Echo, Hybrid Reverb, Roar)
not_available_to_max.instead: live.tab at the top of the body, or a fold-out.

not_available_to_max.live: Expand arrow in the title bar (Saturator, Roar)
not_available_to_max.instead: Fold-out arrow in the display row.

not_available_to_max.live: Vertical side panels (Auto Filter, Roar sidechain / MIDI)
not_available_to_max.instead: A fold-out, or leave the feature out.
